 Early ballots, in person and by mail, through Oct. 30 · Unofficial
 7,706,929
 Early ballots cast in person and by mail through Oct. 30 , the last day of early voting . Unofficial: the Texas Secretary of State ’s Oct. 30 report, which isn’t complete yet.
 At least 20 small counties (0.5% of registered voters) are missing from the state's Oct. 30 file, so the total may run slightly low. 
 Previous state report, Oct. 29 : 6,856,501 early ballots, 36.0 % of registered voters.
 Texas Secretary of State figures , with Hill County’s own count in place of the state’s (state’s figure: 6,855,309 ) .
 Even the Oct. 29 count, 6,856,501 , beats 2022’s entire early vote ( 5,497,027 ).
 In person or by mail, 40.5 % of registered voters voted early , vs. 31.1 % in 2022 .
